description: Free. Named after Max Scheler. Orb Studio records official DWD warnings of level 3+ (Unwetter) with the time first seen, then checks within 24 hours whether any radar headline names the place (state or Germany) and the weather type. Returns the share with no such headline, examples, and a verdict: collecting (fewer than 10 closed events), mostly_reported, mixed, mostly_unreported. 'No headline' means not on our radars (eight topics, our outlets), not that no media reported it. A link between two series, no cause, no rating.
name: get_scheler
title: Measured but not reported: share of official German warnings with no headline on our radars in 24 hours
